reviews.name: Vivian
reviews.text:
We loved Ean’s place so much the first time that we booked it again for Labor Day weekend, and our second stay was just as amazing! The house was once again spotless, comfortable, beautifully decorated, and stocked with everything we needed. We really appreciate all of the thoughtful details throughout the home, and the beds are some of the most comfortable we’ve had at an Airbnb. We spent plenty of time enjoying the pool, jacuzzi, and backyard and loved being able to relax and enjoy the house.

Ean was once again incredibly responsive and a wonderful host. It says a lot when you return to a property so quickly and it is every bit as great as you remembered. This has officially become one of our favorite places to stay in the area. Another 10/10 experience, and we will absolutely be back!

reviews.name: Anival
reviews.text:
Eann’s place was excellent. From the moment we arrived, everything was spotless and well-maintained. The house was spacious, with a large living room and a fully equipped kitchen. The bedrooms were clean, comfortable, and well organized.

The outdoor area was just as impressive. The pool was clean and inviting, and the property included a barbecue, plenty of towels, and everything we needed for a relaxing stay. The kitchen was stocked with cookware, dishes, spices, coffee, and other essentials, making it easy to prepare meals.

Overall, we had a wonderful stay. My kids especially loved spending time in the pool, and we would definitely stay here again. Thank you, Eann, for being a great host!

reviews.name: Nate
reviews.text: I loved how quiet it was no noice. It felt peaceful and felt like I was at home. I loved the saltwater pool it was nice temperature.

reviews.name: Emilia
reviews.text:
We had such a wonderful stay at Terra Luz! From the moment we arrived, the team were incredibly kind, responsive, and genuinely cared about making sure we had the best experience possible.

We did have a small issue with the AC when we first checked in, However, the hosts were quick to respond, checked in with us multiple times, and did everything they could to make things right, which really showed how much they value their guests and stand behind their commitment to excellent hospitality.
The property itself was beautiful, clean, peaceful, and perfect for a relaxing family getaway. The pool was amazing, the outdoor space was well maintained, and the home had everything we needed for a comfortable stay. It felt private, welcoming, and was a great place to unwind.
What truly stood out was the exceptional communication and custome

reviews.name: Ambar
reviews.text: We absolutely loved our stay in Eann’s home . It was beautifully decorated and the entire setup of the home is great , very spacious and cozy . She also provided a lot of amenities , there was nothing to be missed in her home . We loved swimming in the pool and relaxing in the jacuzzi . I would definitely stay here again .

reviews.name: Lauren
reviews.text:
We had an amazing stay at Terra Luz and would absolutely return! We booked it for our son’s 5th birthday weekend, and it ended up being the perfect family getaway.

The home is beautiful, thoughtfully designed, and feels very curated while still being comfortable and welcoming. We visited during triple-digit temperatures, so we spent most of our time enjoying the saltwater pool, grilling outdoors, and making memories together. The AC kept the house cool, and the backyard was exactly what we were hoping for. Our son also loved the board games and magnet tiles.

Everything was clean, well-maintained, and had everything we needed for a long weekend. Traveling with two dogs was easy thanks to the secure fenced yard. Communication was so quick, check-in was seamless, and the entire experience exceeded our expectations.

Thank you for helping make our son’s birthday so special. He still can’t stop talking about his “birthday Airbnb!” Highly recommend to everyone :)

reviews.name: Scott
reviews.text: Eann was very friendly and responsive throughout the trip. The house was perfect for the weekend. Plenty of restaurants and things to do around the neighborhood. We were in the pool all weekend, perfect for the summer. Thanks again.

reviews.name: Tida
reviews.text:
Came out to enjoy a girls weekend in the desert. Check-in was really smooth . This was one of my favorite airbnb stays, the place was BEAUTIFUL! Rooms were well decorated and felt like home. 

We spent all day in the pool and then all night in the jacuzzi!

Host was very kind, responsive and communicative. The place was accurately described - if anything the space was a lot bigger than I expected from the photos! The home felt clean, and secure as it’s in a gated community. The AC worked amazing, and the pool was our favorite, we definitely appreciate the extra towels and floaties. 

I would definitely book here again in the future. Loved the space so much!! Thank you for the hospitality Eann🙏🏽

reviews.name: Monglinh
reviews.text:
Eann was an incredible host for our first family vacation. It felt like an extension of our home, truly. She has put forth a lot of effort and consideration into what her guests may need, especially us as a family with a toddler. 

Sound machines in every room. A day bed with trundle in the primary room so our toddler could sleep close to us but in her own comfortable bed. The beds and linens were super cozy! Throw blankets, matching robes, diaper pails, industrial steamer, she truly thought of everything.

The pool was the perfect size + hot tub worked great. A clear organized garage space to keep your car out of the sun/heat. Pool floats and accessories, too.

As someone who is always considering how to make my own family comfortable it was nice to be in the care of Eann who took so many things off my list to worry about.

I would absolutely book again with Eann.

reviews.name: Jessenia
reviews.text: Eann’s place was beautiful just as shown on the photos and was fully equipped. Eann and co-hosts were super friendly and extremely responsive. Recommend this place for your next getaway!

reviews.name: Amanda
reviews.text: Stayed at Eann’s house for Stagecoach weekend! We were the closest neighborhood to the festival so it made it really convenient. It’s still a bit of walking to the festival itself, so Eann sent us a list of drivers available, we took advantage of that all weekend! They really thought of everything, charging ports on every nightstand, charging ports on the counter, all cabinets labeled to easily find things and all necessity’s stocked. We took advantage of the hot tub and pool and all the decor was so cute! I really appreciate Eann and Brandon were always quick to reply. We had a great time! Thank you again 🥰

reviews.name: Carolyn
reviews.text: Eann was very responsive whenever we had any questions regarding our stay. The house was super clean and we had everything we needed. Will definitely stay here again for Coachella!

reviews.name: Tera
reviews.text: Just a few steps away from the pool! Responsive. Comfortable. Spacious. Easy!

reviews.name: Carson
reviews.text: Eann’s place was just as described and pictured! Great location with great amenities. She was very responsive and helpful and our family had a lovely time. We would stay here (or at any of Eann’s other properties) again in a heartbeat.

reviews.name: Melissa
reviews.text: This place was exactly what I needed! The communication with the host was excellent.

reviews.name: Teemoor
reviews.text: It was a nice house, well-thought-out and prepared, with all needs provided.

reviews.name: Jennifer
reviews.text:
We only stayed for the weekend, but it was the perfect getaway. Eann’s home was beautiful, spotless, and incredibly welcoming. Everything we needed was thoughtfully provided - from towels to dishes and kitchen essentials - which made our stay so convenient and comfortable.

Although we didn’t use the community pool, it was just a short walk away. We did enjoy the private hot tub in the backyard, and it was the perfect way to relax after a day out.

Eann was also an amazing host - friendly, attentive, and very quick to respond to any questions or issues we had. Overall, we had a wonderful experience and would absolutely stay here again. Highly recommended!

reviews.name: Anne
reviews.text:
We had a wonderful stay! This home was perfect for our multi-generational family, including our grandbabies, daughter, husband, and me. The hosts thoughtfully provided so many baby-friendly items, which made traveling with little ones so much easier. The kitchen was incredibly well stocked with everything we needed, and as a coffee lover, I especially appreciated the adorable coffee bar with three different brewing options and all the extras provided.

The host was very responsive and accommodating throughout our stay and even allowed us a late checkout, which made our departure so much more relaxed. We felt comfortable, cared for, and right at home. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Alyssa
reviews.text: We loved staying at the cactus. She had everything we needed for toddler bay needs. Loved the vibes and decor. Truly an excellent place for kids. Added bonus the pool was directly next to the house for an easy walk! Host was very responsive and helpful. Overall, great stay!

reviews.name: Sean
reviews.text: My friend and I had the perfect stay for our annual golf trip at the Cozy Cactus. Eann's home was exactly as listed and was a comfortable respite in between rounds. It was perfectly located for a La Quinta-centric golf trip (mostly PGA West), which kept the driving distances short and simple. It was HOT when we were there and the house was quiet and cool with a covered back patio for morning coffee and contemplation. Eann was exceptionally communicative and responsive throughout our visit and provided one of the most comprehensive welcome packets I've come across in an Airbnb. The house, particularly the kitchen, was well appointed and more than met our needs. We would definitely stay here again, thank you Eann!

reviews.name: James
reviews.text:
My friends and I stayed at Eanns for Coachella weekend and it was the perfect home base for us. For anybody who’s been to Coachella, you know?how long it can take to find an uber or get out of the parking lot at the end of the night, especially if you want to stay till the end of the last set. Staying at Eanns place gave us the peace of mind that no matter how long we stayed we wouldn’t be stuck in a line for hours.

On top of all that Eann was very responsive and accommodating to all our questions and requests during our stay. She’s seriously was one of the best Airbnb hosts I’ve had in a very long time. 

Lastly no exhaustive list of checkout procedures, just a few very reasonable requests. Overall I highly recommend staying at this Airbnb whether it’s for Coachella or any other trip!

reviews.name: Bonnie
reviews.text: Eann was an incredible host, very responsive. Probably one of the best we’ve experienced! The home was just as described and perfect for our family vacation with my 4 and 6 year old, I was able to take our Au Pair and my sister as well! The beds were incredibly comfortable, the kids loved the bunkbeds and fell right asleep, which was a huge win. The pool and hot tub is just across the street and super clean!! They also have a hot tub in the backyard which was magical. We were able to cook all meals at home, (Costco is super close) and reconnect as a family, which was priceless and so overdue❤️🙏. Also the Alexa was 🔥 and a perfect location when you come in the door, we had a mix of Ed Sheeran and baby Beluga the entire time🤣. Thanks again, Eann!! Highly recommend this Airbnb.

reviews.name: Kimberly
reviews.text: The space was perfect for what we needed and the mini golf was an added touch! My son loved it. The pool was literally across the way and easy to get into. Eann was extremely helpful and responded really quickly! Will definitely stay here again in the future.

reviews.name: Alex
reviews.text: Truthfully, this is one of the most beautiful Airbnb’s I’ve had the chance to stay at & incredible for the price. All the amenities were as described and my team and I got so much joy and relaxation. Bed and furniture were incredibly comfortable and the space allotted to us was nothing shy of luxurious. Next time I’m in Indio/Coachella Valley, I’m staying here if it’s available. No doubt whatsoever.
